landing.eyebrow: China AI news · 한국어 · English · 中文
landing.heroTitle:
China’s AI day,
in five minutes every morning.
landing.heroBody: We collect AI articles from six Chinese outlets three times a day, translate and summarize them, and every morning turn the most important developments into a briefing. Every sentence links to its source.
landing.sourcesBody: The outlets that cover China’s AI industry fastest. We read only public feeds and always link to the original.
landing.howTitle: From one article to a briefing
landing.step1Body: New articles from six outlets’ public feeds — up to 80 per run, each article once.
landing.step2Body: Only AI technology, product and business stories are kept, and each is tagged with the country it is about.
landing.step3Body: Titles, summaries and insights in Korean, English and Chinese; bodies cut to a 3–5 sentence gist.
landing.step4Body: The day’s most important developments, organized into five China and three global top stories plus numbers, companies and a term.
landing.step5Body: Automatic checks on numbers and sources, then two independent AI reviews. Published only if both pass; otherwise corrected and reviewed again.
landing.getTodayBody: Five China and three global top stories, the day in numbers, companies to watch and the term of the day
landing.getNewsBody: Search by company or keyword and filter China or US stories
landing.getReportsBody: What changed over a week or a month, in figures and articles
landing.trustTitle: Written by AI — never without a source
landing.trust1Body: Numbers are automatically checked against the cited articles. The original link is always there.
landing.trust2Body: Only editions that pass a separate review step twice are published.
landing.trust3Body: Corrections and withdrawals are logged with reasons, and our method is published in full.
landing.subTitle: Get it from tomorrow morning
landing.subBody: RSS feeds (briefing, region, category) · morning email
